verdict.rationale: Clerk's migration docs describe an open-source tool that bulk-creates users in Clerk from a JSON or CSV file via the Backend API, while respecting rate limits. That covers the import half of the story. Nothing in the pack shows that password hashes carry over, or that users can be exported out of Clerk, so the 'never locked in' half is unevidenced. Missing for 10: password-hash import support, user export capability, independent or hands-on corroboration of the migration tool.
